frame.basis: Use calibrated Animator right-handed holder frame and full actual-loader metre conversion; preserve reflection handling. No world-X anatomical assumption.
frame.referenceStatus: rig-derived with mesh support, anatomical image sign still unconfirmed; not a fitted H2 transform

opening.transition: Shoulder ledges span y=-0.055..-0.050; no lid or top crossbar. Narrow lower rails retain card alignment; upper front/back lips move away from observed knuckles.
opening.turnOnlyAfter: Card bottom is >=0.010m above mouth and complete hand/forearm cleared shell/body.

edgeGripProposal.status: Animator to measure; not a delivered runtime socket
edgeGripProposal.reason: H1 full-right-chain/shell103–105 cases; H2 clears72 saved mouth vertices but14 vertices from the broader saved right-chain sample still intersect in old poses. A new pose/grip is necessary; no old-pose pass.
edgeGripProposal.candidateContact: Opposed contacts on the upper card faces near tangent X=-0.045m, card top edge Y=-0.010m; contact patch suggested X=-0.065..-0.025,Y=-0.018..-0.010,Z=+/-0.0015. These are card-local-in-holder design coordinates, NOT measured fingertip contacts.

distalAccessEnvelope.status: Design corridor for distal pinch only. Not whole hand bounds and not a fitted grip.
distalAccessEnvelope.source: Observed H1 mouth/intersection triangle region with10mm normal margin in the upper well.

edgeGripProposal.palmForearmRule: Keep the complete palm and forearm exterior to actual shell/armour; prefer palm above mouth during insertion. Fit named fingers/contact geometry, not a wrist target or this corridor alone. The saved right-chain sample extends to Z0.1984 and Y-0.1831m; it does not fit in the well.
edgeGripProposal.gripApproval: proposed only; Producer/Animator/Engine must pin any Sam-only change

mount.interface: external bridge plus two rear pads; shell no longer pretends its whole backing is supported
mount.bodyContactAllowed: Only rear -Z faces of mount_pad_left and mount_pad_right, each on independently measured waist armour support. Do not whitelist all backing/bridge/shell triangles.
mount.supportGate: At each pad retain at least3 actual torso samples within2mm and >=1cm2 projected area as a conservative screen; then inspect actual surface fit. Do not waive zero support or mixed-boundary contacts.
mount.fitRule: Re-solve holder pose from actual external support/whole body envelope; never add a canned offset to the rejected H1 anchor. All bridge, lip, guide and non-pad surfaces must clear body; 10mm design margin is separate from unchanged zero-crossing gate.

tolerances.source: unchanged H1 corrected-shell precondition and fit.mjs; no runtime contact thresholds changed

timingAndCustody.concealment: Opaque stepped front/back maintain frontal concealment intent and10mm top recess. Wider top opening may expose card in oblique/top shots; no early hide/open-air reveal permitted.

acceptance.savedSubset: evidence only, inherited endpoint remains failed

intendedCardContact.allowance: card bottom edge only; no whole-shell or hand/body contact exclusion
